neighbours.label: Unclear: best guess, the second part of a titled compound (Moon|stone, Is|olation)
fire: I read The Moonstone and reviewed it on my blog.
There is new art for the game Alien: Isolation online.
We finished Middlemarch and then The Woman in White.
Fans are waiting for the sequel, Dead Space: Extraction.
She read The Sunstone and lent it to me.
The studio released Halo: Combat Evolved that autumn.
I've finished book three, Bleak House.
New art for Prey: Mooncrash has appeared online.
quiet: I read the moon chart and pinned it on my wall.
There is new paint for the fence near the road.
We finished dinner and then washed the white plates.
Fans are waiting for the bus in the rain.
She read the stone tablet and lent me a pen.
The studio closed its doors that autumn.
I've finished lunch at my house.
New shoes for the team have appeared online.

short: second part of a title (weak guess)
notes: Card only, not probed: a scattered list. This records a weak guess.
